name: readable-config-values
goal: Keep config values compact and inspect full declarations without page overflow

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Configs renders complete multiline schema expressions inline, making rows excessively tall and clipping long lines. Compact preview plus complete-value inspection should retain exact source values and revision links.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing entity-preview-groups configVariables covers only scalar values, filtering and historical pageSize. Extend its shared configSnapshot fixture with multiline expressions and long strings; assert compact row geometry, full-value modal, keyboard close and revision isolation at each standard viewport.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Retained red 1bcaed51a: all three existing category-folder cases fail long values stay compact at schema rows of 234-242px. Same checkpoint captured and retained before assertion.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Opus 5.5 implemented two-line expression previews, counts, shared HarnessAction and read-only Modal; exact values, revision links and focus restoration retained. Reviewed all assigned edits; only ExplorerTable product source changed.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Paired red 4ac5b9c9 and green ab25fdba use identical commands, environment profiles and frozen test corpus. All three category-folder cases pass at f6d3a76ee; 66 capture references and 132 contextual observations retained.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Reports check passes 687 tests, formatting, types, lint, build and audit. Root 32 shared-impact/registry/ownership checks, root/Desktop/Hub types and root audit pass. Real historical Configs manually verified: compact rows, exact 12-line schema modal, internal scrolling, close/focus restoration, no page errors. Full CLI/native suites explicitly deferred.
